title: Verify product tag indexation before changing Yoast settings
finding: The supplied settings export suggests product tags may be indexable, but no rendered output or sitemap evidence was provided.
recommended_action: Check representative product tag URLs for rendered meta robots, canonical URL and sitemap inclusion before changing archive visibility.
approval_required: SEO lead approval before product-tag indexation strategy changes.
qa_check: After any setting change, confirm rendered meta robots and sitemap inclusion/exclusion on at least three product tag URLs.
rollback_or_reversal: Restore previous archive visibility setting and purge cache if unexpected deindexing occurs.
